title: Quiet Before the Swarm
start: Speak to Sir Tiffy in Falador Park.

recommended.t: Quick method of travelling to Void Knights' Outpost, e.g. Void familiar (with Void scrolls (Call to Arms)), or to Port Sarim via the Captain's log, or Explorer's ring 3 or 4.
Falador teleport runes (1 law rune, 1 water rune, 3 air runes) or tablet or teleport to the Falador lodestone
Have no items equipped or in your inventory (You will be required to bank everything during the quest.)

kills.t: Torcher (level 45) with no food or prayer (out of body, you cannot die)
Shifter (level 60) with no food or prayer (out of body, you cannot die)

steps.t: Speak to Sir Tiffy Cashien in the Falador Park about the void knights. [Chat: 1 Void Knights. › Accept]

sub.t: Or, if Slug Menace isn't complete [Chat: 2 Void Knights. › Accept]

steps.t: Go to the Void Knights' Outpost.

sub.t: To get there, speak to the Squire on the pier at Port Sarim to travel to the island by ship free of charge. [Chat: 3 I'd like to go to your outpost.]

steps.t: Speak to Commodore Matthias in the north-east building.
Talk to Captain Tyr just south of the building.
Talk to the following people about escaping pests:

sub.t: Knight Bernard [Chat: 3 Have you heard anything about pests escaping? › 4 That's all, thanks.]
Knight Diana [Chat: 3 Have you heard anything about pests escaping? › 4 That's all, thanks.]
Knight Mikhal [Chat: 3 Have you heard anything about pests escaping? › 4 That's all, thanks.]
Jessika [Chat: 4 Have you heard anything about pests escaping? › 5 That's all, thanks.]
Mrs Gord [Chat: 3 Have you heard anything about pests escaping? › 4 That's all, thanks.]
Squire Sam [Chat: 1 Ask about escaped pest. › 2 That's all, thanks.]
Terry Gord [Chat: 3 Have you heard anything about pests escaping? › 4 That's all, thanks.]

steps.t: Talk to Captain Tyr.
Talk to Jessika about the crimes she has committed. [Chat: 5 Confront about a crime. › 3 You let a pest escape to the mainland.]
Talk to Captain Tyr.
Talk to Commodore Matthias.
Agree during the cutscene. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Solve the 3x3 slider puzzle. The border helps you find their correct positions.

sub.t: The centre piece will appear when you have placed the border pieces.

steps.t: Watch the cutscene and continue the dialogue with Commodore Mathias.
Bank all your items, both equipped and in your inventory. Dismiss any pets or familiars.
Return to Sir Tiffy and talk about Void Knights. [Chat: 1 Void Knights.]

sub.t: Or, if Slug Menace isn't complete [Chat: 2 Void Knights.]

steps.t: Talk to Commander Korasi. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to the toll booth to start the puzzle. [Chat: 2 What do I need to do?]
Complete the puzzle:

sub.t: Talk to Bernard and cross with him. [Chat: 1 I'll cross with you.]
Talk to the toll booth to send yourself over. [Chat: 1 Send someone over the bridge. › 1 Yourself]
Talk to Ami or Diana and have them cross together. [Chat: 2 You cross with [Diana/Ami].]
Talk to the toll booth to send Bernard over. [Chat: 1 Send someone over the bridge. › 1 Bernard]
Talk to Bernard and cross with him. [Chat: 1 I'll cross with you.]

steps.t: Right-click assign the people to the following:
Completing the puzzle correctly triggers a cutscene.

Ensure that "Auto Attack" is enabled in the "Combat Mode" settings, or use Revolution or Classic combat mode. Otherwise, this section cannot be completed. If you become stuck, close your client and wait for your character to log out.
Kill the torcher.
Go up the ladder.
Kill the shifter and wait for another cutscene.
Once teleported, talk to Sir Tiffy.
Speak with Captain Tyr at the Void Knights' Outpost.
Quest complete!
